facts.statement: Daurlong is notable for being the first theropod dinosaur closely related to birds in which a preserved intestinal region has been described.
facts.quote: Daurlong represents the first described occurrence of a preserved intestinal region in a theropod closely related to birds.

facts.statement: The holotype specimen of Daurlong was discovered in the Longjiang Formation at the Pigeon Hill locality in Inner Mongolia, China.
facts.quote: The Daurlong holotype specimen, IMMNH-PV00731, was found in sediments of the Longjiang Formation (Pigeon Hill locality) of Morin Dawa Daur Autonomous Banner, Inner Mongolia, China.

facts.statement: Daurlong lived during the Aptian age of the Early Cretaceous period.
facts.quote: This locality is dated to the Aptian age of the Early Cretaceous period.

facts.statement: Daurlong wangi was formally described as a new genus and species in 2022 by a team of researchers including Xuri Wang and Andrea Cau.
facts.quote: In 2022, Daurlong wangi was described as a new genus and species of dromaeosaurid theropod dinosaurs by Xuri Wang, Andrea Cau, Bin Guo, Feimin Ma, Gele Qing, and Yichuan Liu based on these remains.

facts.statement: The genus name Daurlong is a combination of the Daur Nation and the Chinese word for dragon.
facts.quote: The generic name, "Daurlong", combines a reference to the Daur Nation with the Chinese "龙" ("lóng"), meaning "dragon."

facts.statement: The specific name wangi was chosen to honor Wang Junyou, the director of the Inner Mongolia Museum of Natural History.
facts.quote: The specific name, "wangi", honors Wang Junyou, the director of the Inner Mongolia Museum of Natural History.

facts.statement: Daurlong was a mid-sized dromaeosaurid dinosaur approximately 1.5 meters in length.
facts.quote: Daurlong was a mid-sized dromaeosaurid, about 1.5 m long.

facts.statement: Fossil evidence shows that Daurlong preserved plumage along the back of the skull, neck, and the edges of the tail.
facts.quote: The specimen preserves plumage along the back of the skull and neck, and the edges of the tail.

facts.statement: A bluish layer preserved in the ribcage of the Daurlong specimen is interpreted as the intestinal tract.
facts.quote: A bluish layer preserved in the Daurlong specimen ribcage matches the intestinal tract seen in the Scipionyx holotype.

facts.statement: Phylogenetic analyses classify Daurlong as a member of the Dromaeosauridae family within a clade containing Tianyuraptor and Zhenyuanlong.
facts.quote: In their phylogenetic analyses, Wang et al. (2022) recovered Daurlong as a member of the Dromaeosauridae, in a clade containing Tianyuraptor and Zhenyuanlong.

facts.statement: Daurlong was found in the Lower Cretaceous Longjiang Formation of China.
facts.quote: Fue encontrado en la Formación Longjiang del Cretácico Inferior de China.

facts.statement: Daurlong lived approximately 121 million years ago during the Aptian stage of the Early Cretaceous in what is now Asia.
facts.quote: que vivió a mediados del período Cretácico, hace aproximadamente 121 millones de años, en el Aptiense, en lo que es hoy Asia.

facts.statement: The time range for Daurlong is estimated between 121.4 and 119.57 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Aptian to Aptian (121.4 to 119.57 million years ago)

facts.statement: The Daurlong specimen preserves feathers along the back of the skull and neck, as well as the edges of the tail.
facts.quote: El ejemplar conserva el plumaje a lo largo de la parte posterior del cráneo y el cuello, y los bordes de la cola.

facts.statement: Unlike Zhenyuanlong, the Daurlong fossil does not include pennaceous flight feathers (remiges) or tail feathers (rectrices).
facts.quote: El fósil no incluye rectrices y remiges pennáceas , como en Zhenyuanlong .

facts.statement: The holotype consists of a nearly complete individual skeleton, including a nearly perfectly articulated skull.
facts.quote: Consiste en un espécimen casi completo de un individuo, incluido un cráneo casi perfectamente articulado .

facts.statement: A partial anuran skeleton was also preserved on the same slab as the Daurlong holotype.
facts.quote: También se conservó un esqueleto de un anuro parcial en la losa de holotipo.

facts.statement: Wang and colleagues recovered Daurlong as a member of Dromaeosauridae in a clade containing Tianyuraptor and Zhenyuanlong, which are sister taxa to Eudromaeosauria.
facts.quote: En sus análisis filogenéticos , Wang y sus colegas en 2022 recuperaron a Daurlong como miembro de Dromaeosauridae, en un clado que contenía a Tianyuraptor y Zhenyuanlong hermano de Eudromeosauria.
